R11 rim thick solid black ring.finding: R11 `l2-w01-story-page-a-net-line-v1.png` (line art only): the hoop rim of the net is a thick, solid black ring. Draw it at normal line width.
R11 rim thick solid black ring.evidence: The rim is an open ring of two thin parallel lines. The white channel between them is one closed component (bbox 170,25 to 424,299 at 1920 x 1280). Row widths of the channel: minimum 7 px, median 9 px, 90th percentile 15 px. Outline lines are 7 to 17 px. On the 4000 px print the channel measures 14 to 36 px. The ring is never a solid black band.

rim white strip judgment.question: Is the thin white strip between the two rim lines a line gap that makes coloring hard?
rim white strip judgment.evidence: The strip is one closed annular channel. Flood fill from the frame never reaches it. Its width is about one outline line width at every row (minimum 7 px, median 9 px at 1920 x 1280). It never collapses to zero. Line crossings at shallow angles beside the strip leave 1 to 4 px white wedges, and each wedge stays closed. A child can color it or leave it white, and no color can run out of it.
